tactical_thesis: Test seven-ID blocking/healing fusion with a redesigned medical geometry. Spot replaces Melantha's opening lower-outer interception and remains there; Hibiscus moves west to heal Spot, Friston and Ansel. Ansel retains central and extended upper-outer coverage. Steward attacks the eastern artillery circuit from the northern platform, inside Ansel's ordinary range. This removes Melantha's deployment and the exposed lower-outer transfer, but does not inherit M70's survival or artillery-kill timings. The decisive unresolved condition is whether actual artillery targeting permits Ansel to sustain Steward while Hibiscus carries lower recovery. This is a complete unsimulated hypothesis, not a verified WIN.
